advice.R01: Replace the name with a neutral description, e.g. 'A B2B SaaS startup from the DACH region'.
advice.R02: Describe the role and experience without real names (e.g. 'Experienced tech lead with 8 years of industry experience').
advice.R03: Remove web links; data is exchanged only after mutual approval.
advice.R04: Remove contact details; they are exchanged only after approval.
advice.R05: Describe protected technologies abstractly without patent numbers.
advice.R06: Replace specific names with industry categories (e.g. 'Tier-1 automotive manufacturer').
advice.R07: Replace the city with a region (e.g. 'Southern Germany' or 'DACH').
advice.default: Rephrase this section so that the specific company cannot be identified.
